t=time.time(); ar=planner.arc_list(m,m.pairs,want); print('arcs %d %.3f'%(len(ar),time.time()-t))
t=time.time(); fv=planner.flow_vector(m,meta,meta['assign'],want); print('flowvec %.3f'%(time.time()-t))

if hi<len(m.rset):
    wp=m.wants(m.rset[hi]); cut=planner.infeasibility_cut(m,wp,planner.arc_list(m,m.pairs,wp))

t=time.time(); pot=meta['pi'][:m.K]; print('pot %.3f'%(time.time()-t))
# count repair work
orig=planner.repair_potentials
cnt=[0]
def patched(g,pi):
    import collections
    from collections import deque
    d=list(pi); queued=[True]*g.n; pend=deque(range(g.n)); n=0
    to,cap,cost,nxt,head=g.to,g.cap,g.cost,g.nxt,g.head
    while pend:
        n+=1
        u=pend.popleft(); queued[u]=False; base=d[u]; i=head[u]
        while i>=0:
            if cap[i]>0:
                v=to[i]; cand=base+cost[i]
                if cand<d[v]:
                    d[v]=cand
                    if not queued[v]: queued[v]=True; pend.append(v)
            i=nxt[i]
    cnt[0]=n
    return d
